title: Integral models
statement:
Keep the notation of [prop-wf-weil-sheaf-representation-equivalence], and let $U_0\subseteq C_0$ be a
nonempty open subscheme with base change $U$ and geometric fundamental group
$\pi_1(U)$, the kernel of the degree map of $W(U_0)$ by
[lem-wf-weil-group-exact-sequence]. An $\mathcal O_E$-lattice in $V$ means a free
$\mathcal O_E$-submodule of rank $\dim_{E}V$ that spans $V$ over $E$.

Let $(V,\rho)$ be a lisse Weil sheaf on $U_0$, with $\rho$ its Weil
fundamental representation of [def-wf-fundamental-representation]. After replacing $E$ by a
finite extension there is an $\mathcal O_E$-lattice $L\subset V$ with

$$
\rho(\pi_1(U))L=L,\qquad L\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}E=V,
$$

and the image of $\pi_1(U)$ in $\operatorname{Aut}(L/\mathfrak m_E^nL)$ is
finite for every $n$. Such an $L$ is the geometric stalk of a lisse
$\mathcal O_E$-sheaf on $U$.

proof.text:
By [prop-wf-weil-sheaf-representation-equivalence] the representation admits a model over a finite
$E/\Ql$, whose restriction to the geometric subgroup is continuous by
[lem-wf-weil-fundamental-representation]; a further
finite extension absorbs that choice. Since $\pi_1(U)$ is profinite, hence
compact, $\rho(\pi_1(U))$ is a compact subgroup of $\GL(V)$. The orbit of an
arbitrary $\mathcal O_E$-lattice under a compact subgroup is bounded, so the
$\mathcal O_E$-span $L$ of that orbit is again a lattice; it is stable by
construction and of full rank, whence $L\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}E=V$. Each
$L/\mathfrak m_E^nL$ is a finite set, so the image of $\pi_1(U)$ in its
automorphisms is finite, and these reductions form the compatible system of
finite locally constant sheaves whose limit is the lisse $\mathcal O_E$-sheaf
on $U$ with stalk $L$.

blueprint_update.statement:
Let $C_0$ be a smooth geometrically connected curve over $\Fq$, and let
$U_0\subseteq C_0$ be a nonempty open subscheme with base change $U$ and
geometric fundamental group $\pi_1(U)$. For a finite extension $E/\Ql$
inside $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, an $\mathcal O_E$-lattice in a
finite-dimensional $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$-vector space $V$ means a free
$\mathcal O_E$-submodule of rank $\dim V$ whose
$\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$-span is $V$.

Let $\mathcal F$ be a lisse $\overline{\mathbf Q}_{\ell,U}$-module on
$U_{\mathrm{proét}}$ (for instance the sheaf underlying a lisse Weil sheaf
on $U_0$), and let $\rho:\pi_1(U)\to\operatorname{GL}(V)$ be its
geometric fundamental representation of
[thm-lisse-qlbar-representations]. After replacing $E$ by a
finite extension there is an $\mathcal O_E$-lattice $L\subset V$ with

$$
\rho(\pi_1(U))L=L,\qquad L\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell=V,
$$

and the image of $\pi_1(U)$ in $\operatorname{Aut}(L/\mathfrak m_E^nL)$ is
finite for every $n$. Such an $L$ is the geometric stalk of a lisse
$\cO_{E,U}$-module $\mathcal L$ on $U_{\mathrm{proét}}$, locally isomorphic to
$\cO_{E,U}^{\oplus\operatorname{rk}L}$, whose reductions $\mathcal L/\mathfrak m_E^n\mathcal L$
are the finite locally constant sheaves with stalk $L/\mathfrak m_E^nL$, and with
$\mathcal L\otimes_{\cO_{E,U}}\overline{\mathbf Q}_{\ell,U}\simeq\mathcal F$.

proof.text:
The representation $\rho$ is continuous and defined over a finite
$E/\Ql$ by [thm-lisse-qlbar-representations]; a further finite extension
absorbs that choice: there is a $\pi_1(U)$-stable $E$-subspace $V_E$ with
$V_E\otimes_E\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell=V$ on which $\pi_1(U)$ acts
continuously. Since $\pi_1(U)$ is profinite, hence compact,
$\rho(\pi_1(U))$ is a compact subgroup of $\GL(V_E)$. The orbit of an
arbitrary $\mathcal O_E$-lattice in $V_E$ under a compact subgroup is
bounded, so the $\mathcal O_E$-span $L$ of that orbit is again a lattice in
$V_E$; it is stable by construction and of full rank, whence
$L\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell=V_E\otimes_E\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell=V$. Each
$L/\mathfrak m_E^nL$ is a finite set, so the image of $\pi_1(U)$ in its
automorphisms is finite.

*The sheaf $\mathcal L$.* By the finite-coefficient case of
[cor-galois-lisse-representations], the finite continuous $\pi_1(U)$-module
$L/\mathfrak m_E^nL$ is the stalk of a finite locally constant sheaf $\mathcal L_n$ of
$\cO_E/\mathfrak m_E^n$-modules on $U$, with surjective transition maps
$\mathcal L_{n+1}\to\mathcal L_n$. Let $\widetilde U=\varprojlim_iU_i\to U$ be the
pro-finite-étale cover given by the finite étale covers $U_i$ trivializing the
$\mathcal L_n$ (one for each of the finite groups of the statement); it is a
pro-étale cover, and over it
$\mathcal L_n|_{\widetilde U}\simeq(L/\mathfrak m_E^nL)_{\widetilde U}$
compatibly in $n$. Put $\mathcal L=\varprojlim_n\mathcal L_n$ in
$\Sh(U_{\mathrm{proét}})$. Restriction to $\widetilde U$ commutes with limits, so a
choice of basis of $L$ gives
$\mathcal L|_{\widetilde U}\simeq\varprojlim_n(\cO_E/\mathfrak m_E^n)^{\oplus r}_{\widetilde U}
\simeq\cO_{E,\widetilde U}^{\oplus r}$ by the comparison theorem
[sk-prop-sfb-qlbar-colimit-x]. Thus $\mathcal L$ is a lisse $\cO_{E,U}$-module with
stalk $L$ and $\mathcal L/\mathfrak m_E^n\mathcal L\simeq\mathcal L_n$. Its extension of
scalars $\mathcal L\otimes_{\cO_{E,U}}\overline{\mathbf Q}_{\ell,U}$ is a lisse
$\overline{\mathbf Q}_{\ell,U}$-module with geometric representation
$L\otimes_{\cO_E}\Qlb=V$, so it is isomorphic to $\mathcal F$ by
[thm-lisse-qlbar-representations].
